description:
**Description**
Amazon’s Selection Monitoring team is responsible for making the biggest catalog on the planet even bigger. Our systems process billions of products to algorithmically find products not already sold on Amazon and programmatically add them to the Amazon catalog. We apply parallel processing, machine learning and deep learning algorithms to evaluate products and brands in order to identify and prioritize products and brands to be added to Amazon’s catalog. The datasets produced by our team are used by teams across Amazon to improve: product information, search and discoverability, pricing, and delivery experience. Our work involves building state-of-the-art Information Retrieval (IR) systems to mine the web and automatically create structured entities from un-structure/semi-structured data. We constantly stretch the boundaries of large scale distributed systems, Elastic Computing, Big Data, and SOA technologies to tackle challenges at Amazon’s global scale.
  
  
Come join us in our journey to make everything – and yes, we do mean \\*everything\\* – that anyone wants to buy, available on Amazon!
  
  
We are looking for SDEs with strong technical knowledge, established background in engineering large scale software systems, and passion for solving challenging problems. The role demands a high-performing and flexible candidate who can take responsibility for success of the system and drive solutions from design to coding, testing, and deployment, to achieve results in a fast paced environment.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Work with senior Engineers to drive the technical and architectural vision of Selection Monitoring’s External E-commerce source discovery and enrichment.
  
  
Design, build and launch scalable, fault-tolerant, and highly available services and AI Agents that can solve complex problems in entity resolution, deduplication, classification, enrichments and 3rd party data integrations to automatically discovery, catalog, and refresh meta information and signals for millions of eCommerce websites worldwide.
  
  
Build and launch efficient storage solutions for managing large-scale datasets, ensuring optimal performance for both write-heavy ingestion and read-heavy analytical workloads.
  
  
Lead and mentor junior engineers, drive best practices around system design, coding standards, testability, operational excellence, and security for GenAI-integrated systems.
  
  
Drive operational excellence initiatives and continuously improve quality bar for software delivered by the team.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. description:
**About The Role**
The Configuration Developer is responsible for implementing and maintaining business rules within FireLight®, Hexure’s proprietary SaaS electronic fulfillment platform. This role builds on foundational configuration skills to handle moderately complex business logic, ensuring that financial product applications are completed “In-Good-Order” with accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
  
  
The role operates across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from requirements understanding through configuration, testing, and deployment, while also supporting production issues. The Configuration Developer I collaborates closely with internal teams and clients to deliver high-quality solutions, improve user experience, and meet project timelines and KPIs.
  
  
This role actively leverages AI-enabled tools to improve speed, accuracy, and efficiency in rule creation, testing, and troubleshooting, reducing rework and enhancing productivity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Configure and maintain business rules within FireLight® to drive accurate and compliant user experiences for financial product applications
* Implement configuration components including Role Codes, Review Queues, Needs Determination, mapping documents, and admin mappings
* Ensure applications meet “In-Good-Order” standards across completeness, compliance, and business requirements
* Participate across the SDLC including requirements understanding, configuration, testing, and deployment support
* Perform unit and integration testing to validate accuracy and quality of configured business rules
* Support customer deployments, ensuring timely and accurate implementation of configurations
* Monitor and resolve issues via ticketing systems (e.g., Jira), ensuring timely turnaround and minimal client disruption
* Provide Tier 2 production support by troubleshooting configuration-related issues and triaging client tickets
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve defects, improve configurations, and enhance platform performance
* Use AI tools to accelerate rule creation, scenario testing, and issue investigation to improve efficiency and reduce rework
* Ensure adherence to coding best practices including simplicity, modularity, and reusability
* Meet utilization, productivity, and quality benchmarks, including low churn and on-time delivery
* Actively participate in team meetings, providing clear updates on progress, risks, and dependencies

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in a technical or configuration-focused role
* Strong proficiency in XML (creation, editing, troubleshooting) and understanding of structured business logic
* Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) in a SaaS environment
* Familiarity with FireLight® platform components and configuration concepts (or ability to ramp quickly)
* Working knowledge of tools such as Jira (ticketing), OpenAir (time tracking), Notepad++ (rule development), and Adobe Acrobat
* Exposure to integrations with third-party platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Redtail, Yellow Pages) is a plus
* Foundational understanding of financial services domain (insurance, annuities, life insurance processes, compliance requirements)
* Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams
* Self-driven with a learning mindset and willingness to adopt new technologies, including AI-enabled tools
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while contributing effectively as part of a team

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office four days, with the flexibility to work remotely one day (Friday).

iCapital offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes a total compensation program consisting of competitive salary, annual performance bonus, and equity for all full-time employees; healthcare with 100% employer-paid health and dental insurance; and generous paid time off (PTO).

* Proactively identify delivery risks, resolve impediments, lead escalations, and drive decisions to closure.
* Manage release readiness, cutover planning, go-live governance, hypercare, and application support.

* Guide engineering teams on secure coding, design patterns, scalability, resilience, maintainability, testing, and code-quality practices.
* Ensure effective implementation of CI/CD, automated testing, deployment automation, observability, and DevSecOps practices.
* Drive application modernization, cloud-native engineering, reusable components, engineering standards, and technical debt reduction.
* Ensure solutions meet enterprise expectations for security, reliability, performance, compliance, supportability, and cost effectiveness.

* Partner with business stakeholders to define product vision, outcomes, roadmap, priorities, and value measures.
* Translate business goals and user needs into themes, capabilities, features, epics, and prioritized backlogs.
* Balance business value, customer needs, operational risk, architectural priorities, technical debt, and delivery capacity.
* Facilitate product discovery, requirement clarification, prioritization, release planning, and acceptance decisions.
* Use stakeholder feedback, service insights, usage data, and operational learning to drive continuous product improvement.
* Manage the product lifecycle, including introduction, growth, modernization, consolidation, and retirement where applicable.

* Lead or oversee Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Knowledge, Capacity, Availability, and Continuity Management practices.

* Support workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, succession planning, skills development, and capacity management.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, engineering excellence, ownership, transparency, inclusion, continuous improvement, and timely escalation.
* Manage globally distributed internal and external teams and create effective collaboration across locations and time zones.

* Communicate complex technical and delivery topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

* Conduct research and assist senior team members in preparing client presentations and information memorandums.
* Continuously strive towards exceeding client & team expectations and work on increasingly complex assignments
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client/onsite personnel.
